messages:
sam: kicking off quiet-window deploy for v2026.03 -> canary 10% eu-west. pls watch SLOs: https://dash.redwood.local/slo/serve and call out p95/5xx.

deploy-bot: deploy started by sam. version v2026.03. canary 10% -> eu-west-1. notifying @eng-oncall.

anna: seeing embed-route p95 spike to ~400ms vs baseline 210ms. no 5xx yet, but kv cache hit ratio down in eu-west.

mike: quick metric check: `kv_cache_hit_ratio{region="eu-west-1"}` = 0.58, baseline ~0.9. might be shard remap causing cold misses.

ops-sre: hold ramp if p95 stays >350ms for 5m. suggest prewarm KV and restart one proxy pod if needed. preparing rollback plan: rollback -> v2026.02 traffic shift 100% in 60s.

sam: pausing ramp. @deploy-bot hold-ramp. adding note to release draft about eu-west cache warmup.

deploy-bot: hold acknowledged. canary locked at 10%.

mike: starting prewarm job: `tools/prewarm_kv --region eu-west-1 --service embeds` (kicked).

anna: p95 dropping to ~240ms, kv hit -> 0.76. no increase in 5xx.

mike: restarted slow proxy pod; error counters cleared.

ops-sre: prewarm improving hit ratio. recommend ramp to 25% with 5m hold.

sam: @deploy-bot ramp-to 25% over 2m hold 5m. keep monitoring for 15m then full rollout if stable.

deploy-bot: ramp accepted. will alert on p95>350ms or 5xx surge.

anna: updating release notes: "canary observed transient eu-west latency due to KV cache warmup; prewarm mitigated and ramp resumed."

sam: thanks everyone. on-call keep eyes open. if anything flips, execute rollback plan. :white_check_mark:
